key_claims.claim: A co-learning LLM framework applied to 38 million PubMed abstracts reveals systematic underrepresentation of pregnant, breastfeeding, and pediatric populations in pharmacotherapy research.
DeepVEST, a deep learning vessel-erasure tool, reduces vascular obscuration on breast MRI and improves radiologist lesion assessment on maximum intensity projection images.
RETFound, a retina-specific foundation model, does not consistently outperform standard supervised deep learning models for ocular and systemic disease detection across multiple tasks.
MRI-guided PET reconstruction improves inter-reader agreement and quantitative amyloid separation compared to standard OSEM reconstruction in brain PET/MRI.
COVID-19 pneumonia survivors show persistent pulmonary abnormalities on CT and xenon-129 ventilation MRI at five years, even after initially nonsevere illness.
